subject: CYCLE-2 FINDING: Beta2 shell usefulReady is a false readiness semantic; preserve 3-branch wake discriminator
body: Exact Beta2 patcher audit: shell WAKE_INNER_DISPLAY emits innerLogicalId, innerLogicalEnabled, innerLogicalPowered and a field named usefulReady, but usefulReady is defined only as physicalPowered && logicalPowered. It is therefore a command/API receipt, not evidence of first frame, scan-out, useful content or user-visible pixels. The transformed coordinator separately derives proved from fresh topologyNow.innerActive and retries up to 5 attempts at 55 ms, while logging innerActive/innerDefault/shellLogical/shellLogicalPowered/shellUseful/logicalError. For the next Fold7 capture, never promote shellUseful to FIRST_USEFUL_PRESENTATION. Preserve a three-branch classification: A) shellLogical=-1 => Samsung has not exposed an exact inner logical route in the bounded early window; B) shellLogicalPowered=true but innerActive/default remain false => logical power request returned but OEM device-state/layout authority did not promote usable topology; C) logical route/topology becomes active early while glass/content remains dark => downstream composition/presentation bottleneck. Add actual OEM config_supportsConcurrentInternalDisplays read-only probe at startup and same-attempt causal identity. This complements Manager's instrumentation-first Cycle-2 disposition and prevents a false-positive readiness result.
